notes: Geometry and station positions © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL (route relations fetched via Overpass, simplified ~15 m). Covers all 9 Tokyo Metro and 4 Toei lines and JR East lines in Greater Tokyo, clipped to lng 139.0-140.4 / lat 35.2-36.2 (lines are truncated at that box). Interchanges are merged when stations share a Japanese name within ~450 m; differently named transfer stations stay separate. Segment years are first-opening years of each section, rounded (Fukutoshin, Ueno-Tokyo, Shonan-Shinjuku are services on older tracks). JR line colors are JR East line colors (approximate hex); Haneda Access Line and Rinkai Subway have no official colors yet. Upcoming projects: Namboku Shinagawa branch and Yurakucho Toyosu-Sumiyoshi extension (construction, target mid-2030s, shown as 2035), JR Haneda Airport Access Line East route (construction, FY2031) and Rinkai route (planned), Tokyo Rinkai Subway (planned, no official year), Oedo Hikarigaoka-Oizumi-gakuenmachi extension (planned, no official year). Their station positions are approximate (approx) and names provisional. Not included: private railways (Tokyu, Odakyu, Keio, Seibu, Tobu, Keisei, Keikyu, Sotetsu, TX, Rinkai Line), monorails/AGT, and the Tama Monorail extension (construction, FY2034).
